summary: Smart Logistics Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice received on May 1, 2026. The registrant is the issuer. The filing details that the ordinary shares' closing bid price was below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days through April 30, 2026. The company has a 180-day compliance period until October 28, 2026 to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid price for 10 consecutive business days. No deal terms are present. This is a routine listing compliance notice, not a special-situation event.
